title: 트랙 7
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and City Pop fusion. Clean electric guitar plays syncopated funk-style muted strums and rhythmic chords. A warm synth bass follows a groovy, melodic line with frequent slides. Electronic drums feature a crisp snare and a steady kick with occasional sixteenth-note hi-hat flourishes. Shimmering digital pads and bright synth bells provide harmonic texture. Female vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy soprano with light vibrato and layered harmonies during the chorus. Key of E Major, 105 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean funk electric guitar, synth bass, electronic drums]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
셔플을 눌러봐
내 리스트가 돌아
트랙 일곱 번째야
내가 넌 노래야
아직 남아있어 지우지 않았어
밤길을 걸으며
이어폰 볼륨 높여
가로등이 길어져

[Chorus]
[synth pads enter, layered vocal harmonies]
이 노랜 나올 때 너도 듣고 있는 거야
같은 밤 같은 노래
